content.intro: This lesson covers Testing, Debugging, and Structuring Async Applications. It sits in Module 17, Asynchronous Rust, and builds toward a practical Rust mental model rather than memorizing a term in isolation.
content.why_it_matters: Testing, Debugging, and Structuring Async Applications matters when you work with data modelling and exhaustive handling.
